items.label: Complete Comfort
items.value: Featuring a table, a loveseat, and two chairs with plush pillows and cushions, this wicker bistro set lets you comfortably unwind on your patio, deck, or poolside, enjoying a leisurely vacation vibe

items.label: Flexible Arrangement
items.value: The placing of this outdoor furniture set can be easily rearranged to suit your outdoor space and personal preferences, allowing for versatile functionality and adaptability to any setting

items.label: Durable All-weather Construction
items.value: Made with all-weather wicker, this balcony furniture set is waterproof and resistant to rain and snow, ensuring long-term outdoor use on your deck, patio, or porch

items.label: Heavy Duty Frame
items.value: With a robust powder-coated steel frame and tempered glass tabletop, this furniture set is designed to last. Each chair holds up to 300 lb, the loveseat holds up to 500 lb, and the table holds 75 lb

items.label: Easy Maintenance
items.value: The removable pillow and cushion covers are washable, while the faux rattan and powder-coated metal frame can be easily cleaned with a damp cloth, ensuring low maintenance of the patio set
